title: masterdata.changed
description: A master-data table changed (censhare CacheManager/refresh, the all-locales copy). About a table, not an asset; never the records themselves. Source censhare.server (docs/EVENTS.md).

version.description: The detail's schema version. Raised only for a change a subscriber could break on; a new member is not one.

table.description: The master-data table, e.g. party, role, domain.

added.description: Records added, when censhare still had the refresh's list of changes.

ids.description: Numeric ids of the records, at most 100; absent when unknown.

correlationId.description: The X-Ray trace id the server gave the event when it published it (#1088). EventBridge passes it on to the run the event starts, and the server log line for the event names it too.
